title: TensorPlate Control-Loop Metrics
description: Control-loop jitter and frequency stability event (V01-E12-F05). Consumed by the V01-E15 SmolVLA validation harness and the V01-E11 CLI status projection. Formulas are pinned to the v0.1 roadmap: `target_period_ms = 1000 / control_frequency_hz`; `jitter_ms = abs(interval_ms - target_period_ms)`; `instant_frequency_hz = 1000 / interval_ms`; `frequency_error_pct = abs(mean_frequency_hz - control_frequency_hz) / control_frequency_hz * 100`. All timing is monotonic; events derive from successful action outputs only.

monotonic_timestamp_ns.description: Receiver-monotonic timestamp in nanoseconds for the end of the rolling window.

rolling_window_seconds.description: Length of the rolling window in seconds. v0.1.0 default is 60s; producers may shorten the window for fast feedback during early VLA validation.

control_frequency_hz.description: Configured target control frequency. Missing or non-positive values disable control-loop metrics with a typed config warning.

labels.description: Bounded label set (V01-E12-F05). Only the keys below are allowed; producers must drop or normalise out-of-policy values before emission.

samples.description: Count of inter-output intervals in the rolling window.

missed_deadlines.description: Count of intervals where `interval_ms > target_period_ms + grace_ms`.
